items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Well four of us joined, there was the bass player, Barney Kessel — not Barney Kessel — Barney Spieler, was our bass player.

ctx.x: Well four of us joined, there was the bass player, Barney Kessel — not Barney Kessel — Barney Spieler, was our bass player. Later on he got killed in an auto accident in Holland, he had moved to Holland and was playing in a symphony there and he was killed. That was the bass player in the Navy band.
We were talking about the Goodman trumpet section.
